newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran president nominates Zanganeh new oil minister.
newsitem.headline: Iran president nominates Zanganeh new oil minister.

text.p: Iran's new President Mohammad Khatami on Tuesday nominated outgoing energy minister Bijan Namdar Zanganeh as oil minister in his cabinet, the official news agency IRNA reported.

If confirmed by Iran's parliament, or Majlis, Zanganeh would replace veteran oil minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh who is expected to retain an important position in a mediating council headed by outgoing president Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
As energy minister, Zanganeh oversaw Iran's domestic power sector and its non-petroleum related energy sector.
Iran is the world's third largest oil exporter behind Saudi Arabia and Norway and is the second largest producer in the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
Crude output is 3.6 million barrels a day.
